how: Marked across three sessions, each against a tape of the model's own calls. Weaker evidence than IMG_2528's key, which was marked blind, because a tape showing the model's output can only surface what was chosen to correct -- so absence of a mark here is not proof there was no shot. The named false positives are the strong half: review watched those specific calls and said what each really was.
